home.name: Home
home.purpose: Your instance at a glance: what needs your attention, what you opened recently, and your work.

catalog.name: Catalog
catalog.purpose: Find tables, their columns, health and lineage.

queries.name: Queries
queries.purpose: Write SQL, run one query and download its result.

jobs.name: Jobs
jobs.purpose: See jobs and their runs; start, cancel and resume them.

connections.name: Connections
connections.purpose: The databases and services your assets load from.

access.name: Access
access.purpose: People, groups, grants, tokens and secrets.

settings.name: Settings
settings.purpose: Instance status, environments and how this server is set up.

comingSoon.part: This screen comes in part {{part}} of the interface.
comingSoon.useCli: Until then, use the command line:
comingSoon.selectAndCopy: Select the line and copy it.

palette.placeholder: Go to a place or run a command

notFound.title: This page does not exist
notFound.body: Check the address, or start again from Home.

notAvailable.title: You cannot use {{area}}
notAvailable.body: Ask an administrator if you need it.

home.noAccessYet: You have no access yet; ask an administrator.

ended.idle: Your session ended after a time without activity. Sign in again.
ended.lifetime: Your session reached its maximum length and ended. Sign in again.
ended.sign_out_everywhere: You signed out on every device.
ended.ended_by_admin: An administrator ended your session. Sign in again.
ended.replaced: A newer sign-in in this browser replaced this session. Sign in again.
ended.deactivated: Your account is deactivated, so your session ended. Ask an administrator to reactivate it, then sign in again.
ended.token_revoked: The token this session was created with was revoked or expired, so the session ended. Sign in again.
ended.recovery: Your account was recovered with a recovery link, which ended every earlier session. Sign in again with your new passkey.
ended.passkey_copied: A copy of one of your passkeys was detected; it is disabled and every session of your account was ended. Sign in with another passkey, or ask an administrator for a recovery link.
ended.passkey_removed: An administrator removed one of your passkeys, which ended your sessions. Sign in again with another passkey, or ask an administrator for a recovery link.
ended.reactivated: Your account was reactivated, which ended every earlier session and removed its passkeys. Ask the server operator for a new sign-in link.

errors.unreachable: Lakana could not be reached. Check that the server is running and your network works, then try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong in the interface. Reload the page and try again.

passkey.cancelled: The passkey request was cancelled or took too long. Try again when you are ready.
passkey.unsupported: This browser cannot use passkeys. Use a current version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
passkey.duplicate: This device already holds a passkey for this account. Use another device or security key, or sign in with the passkey you have.
passkey.wrongAddress: Passkeys work only at the address Lakana was set up with. Open Lakana at that address and try again.
passkey.failed: The browser could not use the passkey ({{name}}). Try again, or use another device.

signIn.title: Sign in to Lakana
signIn.intro: Sign in with your passkey: your fingerprint, face, PIN or security key.
signIn.refused: This passkey did not sign you in: it may belong to another Lakana server, or it was removed. Try another passkey, or ask an administrator for a recovery link.
signIn.noPasskey: No passkey on this device? Ask an administrator for a recovery link.

link.signInIntro: This link signs you in once. Continue only if you asked for it.
link.joinIntro: This invitation creates your account. Continue only if you expected it.

used.title: This link was already used
used.body: Each sign-in link works once. Sign in with your passkey, or ask whoever sent the link for a new one.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: Ask whoever sent it for a new link, or sign in with your passkey.

withdrawn.title: This link was withdrawn
withdrawn.body: Ask whoever sent it for a new link, or sign in with your passkey.

unknown.title: This link does not work
unknown.body: Check that you opened all of it, including everything after #, or ask whoever sent it for a new link.

link.replaces: This browser is signed in as {{name}}; continuing signs that session out.

addPasskey.title: Add a passkey
addPasskey.required: You signed in with a link that works once. Add a passkey now: from then on it signs you in with your fingerprint, face, PIN or security key.
addPasskey.offer: Sign in faster next time: add a passkey, and this device signs you in with your fingerprint, face, PIN or security key. You can also add one later.

notices.label: Sign-in notices
notices.dismissFailed: The notice could not be dismissed: {{detail}}

recovery_used.self: A recovery link was used on your account on {{date}}. If this was not you, tell an administrator at once.
recovery_used.other: A recovery link was used on the account of {{subject}} on {{date}}.

passkey_disabled.self: One of your passkeys was disabled on {{date}} because a copy of it was detected. Sign in with another passkey, or ask an administrator for a recovery link, and tell an administrator if you did not copy it.
passkey_disabled.other: A passkey of {{subject}} was disabled on {{date}} because a copy of it was detected.

passkey_added.self: A passkey was added to your account on {{date}}. If this was not you, tell an administrator at once.
passkey_added.other: A passkey was added to the account of {{subject}} on {{date}}.

other.self: Something changed about signing in to your account on {{date}}.
other.other: Something changed about signing in to the account of {{subject}} on {{date}}.
